sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日时事通讯DealBook的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市DealBook峰会的现场，采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领袖，其中包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经滤镜的实时对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on
sentences.zh: 我们将于11月18日在nytimes.com上现场直播精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: November 18th.
If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用来观看，并免费访问我们所有的新闻报道一个月。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望大家准时收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你绝对不想错过。

sentences.en: From New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is a daily today.
sentences.zh: 这里是今日每日新闻。

sentences.en: A major breakthrough in the race to develop a vaccine for the coronavirus is raising hopes that mass immunization could bring the pandemic to an end.
sentences.zh: 在开发冠状病毒疫苗的竞赛中取得的重大突破，让人燃起了通过全民免疫终结大流行的希望。

sentences.en: We turn to our colleague, science writer Carl Zimmer.
sentences.zh: 我们转向我们的同事、科学作家卡尔·齐默。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, November
sentences.zh: 今天是11月

sentences.en: 12th.
sentences.zh: 12日，星期四。

sentences.en: Carl, tell me how you learned the news about this vaccine.
sentences.zh: 卡尔，告诉我你是怎么听到这个疫苗的消息的。

sentences.en: So Sunday afternoon, I'm sitting on my deck doing a little work on a story and I get a message from my colleague, Katie Thomas.
sentences.zh: 周日下午，我正坐在露台上处理一篇报道的工作，然后我收到了同事凯蒂·托马斯的短信。

sentences.en: And Katie says, this is it guys.
sentences.zh: 凯蒂说，就是这个了，伙计们。

sentences.en: And I knew what it meant.
sentences.zh: 我立刻心领神会。

sentences.en: What it meant was that the drug company Pfizer had some big news.
sentences.zh: 这意味着制药公司辉瑞有了重大消息。

sentences.en: We knew that Pfizer had been doing clinical trials on a vaccine and that they were very far along with it and that they might even be finding out soon
sentences.zh: 我们知道辉瑞一直在对一种疫苗进行临床试验，他们的进展非常顺利，而且他们可能很快就会发现

sentences.en: whether the vaccine actually worked or not.
sentences.zh: 疫苗到底有没有用。

sentences.en: So I start reading a draft of Pfizer's press release.
sentences.zh: 所以我开始阅读辉瑞新闻稿的草稿。

sentences.en: And the first thing I read is, vaccine candidate was found to be more than 90% effective in preventing
sentences.zh: 我读到的第一件事是，在预防

sentences.en: COVID-19.
sentences.zh: 新冠肺炎方面，候选疫苗的有效性被发现超过了90%。

sentences.en: And I just have to stop.
sentences.zh: 我不得不停下来。

sentences.en: I think I am not reading this correctly.
sentences.zh: 我想我一定是看错了。

sentences.en: I actually went back and started reading it over again because my brain could not accept that 90% figure.
sentences.zh: 我甚至回过头重新开始读，因为我的大脑无法接受90%这个数字。

sentences.en: I even wondered if maybe they had typed nine instead of five.
sentences.zh: 我甚至在想，他们是不是把5误打成9了。

sentences.en: They actually meant 50%.
sentences.zh: 他们其实指的是50%。

sentences.en: But no, there it was, 90%.
sentences.zh: 但没有，它就摆在那里，90%。

sentences.en: And Carl, why is a 90% effectiveness rate for a coronavirus vaccine, why is that so astonishing?
sentences.zh: 卡尔，为什么冠状病毒疫苗90%的有效率会如此令人震惊？

sentences.en: It's astonishing because we didn't even know if this would work at all, period.
sentences.zh: 这令人震惊，因为我们甚至不知道这到底能不能行得通，完全不知道。

sentences.en: Because no one has made a licensed vaccine for people for any kind of coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 因为从来没有人为人类制作过针对任何冠状病毒的获批疫苗。

sentences.en: So it could have completely failed, totally.
sentences.zh: 所以它可能彻底失败，完完全全地失败。

sentences.en: The FDA had said, well, if you can get it to be 50% efficacious, that will be good.
sentences.zh: 美国食品药品监督管理局曾表示，嗯，如果你们能让它达到50%的有效率，那就很好了。

sentences.en: That's the minimum we want.
sentences.zh: 那是我们的最低要求。

sentences.en: And so I certainly had adjusted my expectations.
sentences.zh: 所以我当然已经调整了我的期望。

sentences.en: But over 90%, at least in this preliminary data, puts it at least in the ballpark with some of our most potent vaccines that we have.
sentences.zh: 但超过90%，至少在这份初步数据中，让它至少与我们拥有的一些最强效的疫苗不相上下。

sentences.en: So Carl, let's put that 90% figure into some context.
sentences.zh: 那么卡尔，让我们把90%这个数字放在具体的背景下来看。

sentences.en: What was Pfizer testing?
sentences.zh: 辉瑞当时在测试什么？

sentences.en: How many people was it testing?
sentences.zh: 它测试了多少人？

sentences.en: And how does it get to 90%?
sentences.zh: 它是如何得出90%这个数字的？

sentences.en: What does that mean?
sentences.zh: 这意味着什么？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And it's important to understand that this is preliminary data.
sentences.zh: 而且必须明白，这是初步数据。

sentences.en: And the final results will probably be different.
sentences.zh: 最终结果可能会有所不同。

sentences.en: That's just how science works.
sentences.zh: 科学的运作方式就是这样。

sentences.en: So in July, Pfizer launched a clinical trial that has been recruiting 44,000 people.
sentences.zh: 所以在7月份，辉瑞启动了一项临床试验，招募了44,000人。

sentences.en: A lot of people.
sentences.zh: 非常多的人。

sentences.en: A lot of people.
sentences.zh: 非常多的人。

sentences.en: You need a lot of people to know if vaccines work.
sentences.zh: 你需要大量的人来弄清楚疫苗是否有效。

sentences.en: And what they did was they gave half of those people the vaccine.
sentences.zh: 他们的做法是给其中一半人接种疫苗。

sentences.en: They got two doses separated by three weeks.
sentences.zh: 他们接种了两剂，间隔三周。

sentences.en: The other half got a placebo.
sentences.zh: 另一半人接种了安慰剂。

sentences.en: They got salt water.
sentences.zh: 他们注射的是盐水。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so then they waited.
sentences.zh: 然后他们就等待。

sentences.en: What they were waiting for was for people in the trial to get COVID.
sentences.zh: 他们等待的是试验中的人感染新冠。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And then after a certain number of people got sick, then a special outside group of advisors
sentences.zh: 然后在一定数量的人生病后，一个特殊的外部顾问小组

sentences.en: would take a look at the data and see, well, how many of the sick people got vaccinated and how many of the sick people got the placebo.
sentences.zh: 会查看数据，看看生病的人中有多少接种了疫苗，多少接种了安慰剂。

sentences.en: So far, they have only examined 94 people who got sick.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，他们只检查了94名生病的人。

sentences.en: Based on that alone, their estimate is that the vaccine is over 90% effective.
sentences.zh: 仅根据这一点，他们的估计是疫苗的有效率超过90%。

sentences.en: Carl, 94 cases doesn't seem like a whole lot of cases, especially given the number of people that Pfizer recruited.
sentences.zh: 卡尔，94个病例似乎并不是很多病例，考虑到辉瑞招募的人数。

sentences.en: So what do you make of that?
sentences.zh: 所以你怎么看？

sentences.en: Well, actually, statistically speaking, 94 cases is a pretty good number if you're trying to figure out if the vaccine is effective or not.
sentences.zh: 嗯，实际上，从统计学上讲，如果你想弄清楚疫苗是否有效，94个病例是一个相当不错的数字。

sentences.en: It's kind of like rolling dice.
sentences.zh: 这有点像掷骰子。

sentences.en: If you were to roll dice once and get snake eyes, you'd look at it and say, okay, whatever.
sentences.zh: 如果你掷一次骰子掷出两个一，你看一眼会说，好吧，随便吧。

sentences.en: If you did it again and got snake eyes a second roll, you'd say, that's odd.
sentences.zh: 如果你再掷一次，第二次又掷出两个一，你会说，这挺奇怪的。

sentences.en: And if you kept rolling the dice and nine out of 10 times you got snake eyes, you would know that there was something funny with the dice.
sentences.zh: 如果你继续掷骰子，十次中有九次你都掷出两个一，你就会知道这骰子有点不对劲。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, you know, if you get a whole bunch of people in your set of 94 sick people who had the placebo and very few had the vaccine, that's telling you something important.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，如果你在94个生病的人中发现一大堆人注射的是安慰剂，而只有极少数人接种了疫苗，那就说明了一些重要的问题。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Carl, you said that this clinical trial isn't complete.
sentences.zh: 卡尔，你刚才说这个临床试验还没有完成。

sentences.en: You called it, I think, preliminary data.
sentences.zh: 我想你称之为初步数据。

sentences.en: How preliminary?
sentences.zh: 有多初步？

sentences.en: And why publish data early?
sentences.zh: 为什么要过早公布数据？

sentences.en: Well, it's a standard thing in clinical trials that at certain pre-specified times, a drug company will take a look at how the trial is going.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是临床试验中的标准做法，在某些预先指定的时间点，制药公司会查看试验的进展情况。

sentences.en: And when drug companies get early promising preliminary results, they send out a press release and usually no one pays attention to them because
sentences.zh: 当制药公司获得早期的、有希望的初步结果时，他们会发布新闻稿，通常没有人会关注它们，因为

sentences.en: we're not in the middle of a pandemic usually.
sentences.zh: 我们通常不是正处于大流行之中。

sentences.en: But suddenly everybody is paying very close attention to clinical trials and all their tiny little details.
sentences.zh: 但突然之间，每个人都在密切关注临床试验及其所有微小的细节。

sentences.en: And so this was a case where they took an early look and an agreed upon time.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个他们在商定的时间进行早期查验的例子。

sentences.en: And the early look is really good.
sentences.zh: 而且这个早期查验结果非常好。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So let's talk about what we know about how this vaccine that so far is 90% effective in
sentences.zh: 那我们来谈谈我们所知道的，关于这种在预防

sentences.en: preventing coronavirus infections, how it actually works, how it functions, how it confers immunity in the people who get it.
sentences.zh: 冠状病毒感染方面目前已有90%有效率的疫苗，它究竟是如何运作的、如何发挥作用的、如何在接种者体内产生免疫力的。

sentences.en: And recognizing that this science is pretty complicated, I ask you to make it simple.
sentences.zh: 鉴于这门科学相当复杂，我请你把它讲得简单一点。

sentences.en: So in general, what vaccines do is they teach your immune system a very important lesson.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，疫苗的作用是给你的免疫系统上一堂非常重要的课。

sentences.en: They instruct your immune system how to recognize a virus and mount a really fast attack on it.
sentences.zh: 它们指导你的免疫系统如何识别病毒并发起极其迅速的攻击。

sentences.en: The typical way that this happens is that, let's say you get a flu shot.
sentences.zh: 发生这种情况的典型方式是，比方说你打了流感疫苗。

sentences.en: What you might get would be dead flu viruses, essentially.
sentences.zh: 你得到的基本上是灭活的流感病毒。

sentences.en: And they're floating around.
sentences.zh: 它们四处漂浮。

sentences.en: They can't make you sick because they're dead.
sentences.zh: 它们不会让你生病，因为它们是死的。

sentences.en: But their proteins get touched by immune cells.
sentences.zh: 但它们的蛋白质会被免疫细胞接触到。

sentences.en: And the immune cells say, hmm, that's interesting.
sentences.zh: 免疫细胞会说，嗯，这很有意思。

sentences.en: That's new.
sentences.zh: 这是新的。

sentences.en: And they essentially learn how to make antibodies to it and how to kill infected cells because they know what a flu virus looks like.
sentences.zh: 它们基本上学会了如何针对它产生抗体，以及如何杀死受感染的细胞，因为它们知道流感病毒长什么样。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So when the real thing arrives, you're prepared.
sentences.zh: 所以当真正的病毒到来时，你已经准备好了。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: So Carl, is that how the Pfizer coronavirus vaccine works with basically dead elements of the coronavirus injected into people?
sentences.zh: 所以卡尔，辉瑞的冠状病毒疫苗就是这样工作的吗，基本上就是把冠状病毒的灭活成分注射到人体内？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不是的。

sentences.en: Pfizer is using a new design for a vaccine.
sentences.zh: 辉瑞使用的是一种全新的疫苗设计。

sentences.en: Instead of delivering proteins from the virus into our bodies, the vaccine is actually delivering genetic instructions for making virus proteins into our bodies.
sentences.zh: 疫苗没有将病毒的蛋白质输送到我们的体内，而是实际上将用于制造病毒蛋白质的遗传指令输送到我们的体内。

sentences.en: You've got these little genetic instructions in these molecules called RNA, which are wrapped up in little oily bubbles.
sentences.zh: 你把这些微小的遗传指令放在这些被称为RNA的分子中，它们被包裹在微小的油性气泡里。

sentences.en: And those oily bubbles go into our muscle cells, delivering those genetic instructions.
sentences.zh: 这些油性气泡进入我们的肌肉细胞，传递这些遗传指令。

sentences.en: And so now our cells get these instructions and they say, okay, I will make this protein.
sentences.zh: 现在我们的细胞收到了这些指令，它们会说，好的，我来制造这个蛋白质。

sentences.en: It just so happens to be a protein from a coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 碰巧它就是冠状病毒的一种蛋白质。

sentences.en: And then these cells release the proteins into the rest of our body.
sentences.zh: 然后这些细胞将蛋白质释放到我们身体的其他部位。

sentences.en: And immune cells that are wandering around bump into these viral proteins and say, hmm, what's this?
sentences.zh: 四处游荡的免疫细胞撞上这些病毒蛋白质，会说，嗯，这是什么？

sentences.en: And they start making antibodies to them.
sentences.zh: 然后它们开始针对这些蛋白质产生抗体。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: All right, Carl, let me just speak on behalf of potentially terrified listeners.
sentences.zh: 好的，卡尔，我仅代表那些可能感到害怕的听众说几句。

sentences.en: Our body starts producing coronavirus proteins?
sentences.zh: 我们的身体开始产生冠状病毒的蛋白质了？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: That sounds a little scary.
sentences.zh: 这听起来有点吓人。

sentences.en: Well, you have to bear in mind that an individual virus protein is not going to make you sick.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你必须记住，单个的病毒蛋白质是不会让你生病的。

sentences.en: In order for a virus to make you sick, it's got to have all these genes that it uses to hijack
sentences.zh: 为了让病毒使你生病，它必须拥有所有这些基因，用来劫持

sentences.en: your cell and then to produce millions of new viruses that spill out and infect other cells.
sentences.zh: 你的细胞，然后产生数百万个新病毒，这些新病毒会涌出并感染其他细胞。

sentences.en: One viral protein on its own, it doesn't do anything.
sentences.zh: 单凭一个病毒蛋白质，它什么也做不了。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So it may sound scary, but it's not.
sentences.zh: 所以它听起来可能很吓人，但其实并不是。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So if the coronavirus were a person, then this would be like this discarded toenail.
sentences.zh: 所以如果把冠状病毒比作一个人，这就好比是它丢弃的脚趾甲。

sentences.en: It would be this sad little element of the virus, not a risk, but something that if created in the human body would trigger an immune response.
sentences.zh: 它将是病毒那悲伤而微小的组成部分，不是一种风险，而是一种如果在人体内产生就会引发免疫反应的东西。

sentences.en: That's correct.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: You got it.
sentences.zh: 你答对了。

sentences.en: And Carl, do we know from Pfizer how long this immunity lasts based on the data that they have published?
sentences.zh: 卡尔，根据辉瑞已经公布的数据，我们知道这种免疫力能持续多久吗？

sentences.en: That's an incredibly important question, and the answer is we do not know how long it lasts.
sentences.zh: 这是一个极其重要的问题，答案是我们不知道它能持续多久。

sentences.en: Vaccines can last for different lengths of time.
sentences.zh: 疫苗的持续时间可以长短不一。

sentences.en: You know, flu vaccines are really only good for about a year because the flu changes.
sentences.zh: 你知道，流感疫苗实际上只能维持大约一年，因为流感会变异。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There are other vaccines you can take, that you get as a child, and they can last your whole life.
sentences.zh: 还有你可以接种的其他疫苗，那是你在小时候打的，它们可以持续你的一生。

sentences.en: We don't know whether this vaccine even lasts a year.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至不知道这种疫苗是否能持续一年。

sentences.en: Maybe it'll last a few months.
sentences.zh: 也许它只能持续几个月。

sentences.en: We're going to have to wait and see.
sentences.zh: 我们只能拭目以待。

sentences.en: You know, these are early days yet.
sentences.zh: 你知道，现在还处于早期阶段。

sentences.en: So Carl, given everything you've told us about the early effectiveness of this vaccine,
sentences.zh: 所以卡尔，鉴于你告诉我们关于这种疫苗早期有效性的所有情况，

sentences.en: but knowing that this clinical trial is not yet complete, what do we expect will be a timetable for this vaccine to potentially be approved by U.S.
sentences.zh: 但又知道这项临床试验尚未完成，我们预计美国

sentences.en: regulators?
sentences.zh: 监管机构可能批准该疫苗的时间表会是怎样的？

sentences.en: It's not a foregone conclusion that Pfizer is going to get an authorization for the vaccine.
sentences.zh: 辉瑞是否能获得该疫苗的授权并不是板上钉钉的事。

sentences.en: We still have to wait for them to collect more data from this trial.
sentences.zh: 我们仍然需要等待他们收集这项试验的更多数据。

sentences.en: They need to make sure not only that it's effective, but they also want to ensure that it's safe.
sentences.zh: 他们不仅需要确保它有效，还希望确保它是安全的。

sentences.en: So far, there's been no serious adverse effects.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，还没有出现严重的不良反应。

sentences.en: So if they meet all those benchmarks, my bet is that at the end of November, they're going to approach the FDA and they're going to say, here, we want to apply for what's called
sentences.zh: 所以如果他们达到所有这些基准，我敢打赌，在11月底，他们将接洽美国食品药品监督管理局，并会说，这里，我们想申请所谓的

sentences.en: an emergency use authorization.
sentences.zh: 一项紧急使用授权。

sentences.en: The FDA is then going to take this application, which may be literally
sentences.zh: 然后，FDA将着手处理这份申请，内容可能多达

sentences.en: 100,000 pages of documentation.
sentences.zh: 10万页的资料。

sentences.en: And they're going to go through it very carefully.
sentences.zh: 他们将非常仔细地进行审查。

sentences.en: They're going to run their own analysis on the data to see if it meets their standards.
sentences.zh: 他们将对数据进行自己的分析，看看是否符合其标准。

sentences.en: Won't happen in a day or two, but it might happen in a couple of weeks.
sentences.zh: 这不会在一两天内发生，但可能在几周内发生。

sentences.en: And if they say yes, then Pfizer will have the green light to go forward with starting to distribute the vaccine.
sentences.zh: 如果他们同意，那么辉瑞公司将获得绿灯，开始推进疫苗的分发工作。

sentences.en: And I want to talk about distribution because that feels really important.
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈分发的问题，因为这真的很重要。

sentences.en: And accepting what you just said, that we don't want to put the cart before the horse.
sentences.zh: 并且接受你刚才所说的话，我们不能本末倒置。

sentences.en: We don't know if this is going to be approved.
sentences.zh: 我们还不知道这是否会获批。

sentences.en: But I recall from previous conversations with our colleagues on a science desk that the United States has been working with big pharmaceutical companies in this project,
sentences.zh: 但我从之前与科学栏目同事的谈话中记起，美国一直在与大型制药公司合作开展这个项目，

sentences.en: Operation Warp Speed, to make sure that it is manufacturing vaccines even before they are approved.
sentences.zh: 即“沃速率行动”，以确保在疫苗获批之前就开始生产。

sentences.en: So is this one of those vaccines that's already being manufactured?
sentences.zh: 那么，这是否是已经开始生产的疫苗之一？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Pfizer has factories that are making this vaccine already.
sentences.zh: 辉瑞有已经在生产这种疫苗的工厂。

sentences.en: And if this vaccine does get authorized, they are going to ramp up and start making it in huge amounts right away.
sentences.zh: 如果这种疫苗真的获得授权，他们将立即加大力度，开始大量生产。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And when, theoretically, might Americans start to get a vaccine from Pfizer?
sentences.zh: 从理论上讲，美国人什么时候才能开始从辉瑞获得疫苗？

sentences.en: I think January would be a reasonable expectation for enough of the vaccine for maybe 20 million people.
sentences.zh: 我认为，到1月份，有足够的疫苗供大约2,000万人使用是一个合理的预期。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: That's pretty soon.
sentences.zh: 那挺快的。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: It is shatters all records for vaccine development.
sentences.zh: 它打破了疫苗研发的所有记录。

sentences.en: But I should make it clear that initially, only certain people are going to be getting this vaccine.
sentences.zh: 但我必须明确的是，最初只有特定的人群才能接种这种疫苗。

sentences.en: Healthcare workers may get it.
sentences.zh: 医护人员可能会接种。

sentences.en: Certain vulnerable populations may get it firSt. But the general population will not have access to this vaccine probably until the spring.
sentences.zh: 某些弱势群体可能会优先接种。但普通大众可能要到春天才能获得这种疫苗。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Carl, what does Pfizer's experience here mean for the rest of the vaccines that are under development that we keep hearing about from rival companies?
sentences.zh: 卡尔，辉瑞的这次经验对于我们不断听说的来自竞争对手公司的其他正在研发的疫苗意味着什么？

sentences.en: Does this vaccine supersede them?
sentences.zh: 这款疫苗会取代它们吗？

sentences.en: Does it help them?
sentences.zh: 会对它们有帮助吗？

sentences.en: Does it hurt them?
sentences.zh: 会对它们有害吗？

sentences.en: Well, if Pfizer's vaccine works as well as it seems to from these preliminary results, that actually suggests that the others might work as well.
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果辉瑞的疫苗像这些初步结果显示的那样有效，这实际上表明其他的疫苗也可能有效。

sentences.en: Because they are all using the same part of the virus as their target, a protein called spike.
sentences.zh: 因为它们都将病毒的同一部分作为靶标，即一种叫做刺突蛋白的蛋白质。

sentences.en: And so if Pfizer's spike vaccine seems to be so effective, then that suggests that vaccines made by other companies like AstraZeneca or Johnson & Johnson
sentences.zh: 所以，如果辉瑞的刺突疫苗看起来如此有效，那就说明其他公司（如阿斯利康或强生公司）制造的疫苗

sentences.en: and so on, they may be effective as well.
sentences.zh: 等等，它们也可能是有效的。

sentences.en: And so now instead of just having one authorized vaccine for COVID, who knows?
sentences.zh: 因此，现在我们不仅仅只有一种获批的新冠疫苗，谁知道呢？

sentences.en: I mean, we could see many of these.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们可能会看到许多这样的疫苗。

sentences.en: And that's a really important thing if we're going to try to get everybody vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 如果我们想让每个人都接种疫苗，这是一件非常重要的事情。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Because Pfizer alone is not going to be able to do it very quickly.
sentences.zh: 因为仅凭辉瑞公司自己是无法很快做到这一点的。

sentences.en: But if we have other companies producing authorized vaccines of their own in their own factories, then we can get hundreds of
sentences.zh: 但如果我们有其他公司在自己的工厂生产获得授权的疫苗，那么我们就可以在几个月内

sentences.en: millions of vaccines churning out in a matter of months.
sentences.zh: 产出数亿剂疫苗。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This is the dream scenario, given the nightmare that we are in.
sentences.zh: 鉴于我们目前身处噩梦之中，这是梦想中的场景。

sentences.en: Multiple vaccines approved and being manufactured, being distributed so that we achieve a pretty high degree of immunity throughout the United States.
sentences.zh: 多种疫苗获得批准并正在生产、分发，以便我们在全美范围内实现相当高水平的免疫力。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And again, you know, this is something that, you know, I really, really hope happens.
sentences.zh: 而且再次强调，你知道，这是我非常、非常希望发生的事情。

sentences.en: We're not going to know if it can happen until that data really starts coming out.
sentences.zh: 在这些数据真正开始出来之前，我们不会知道它是否能够发生。

sentences.en: But this week we had some really, really encouraging news that gives us reason to be hopeful.
sentences.zh: 但本周我们有一些非常、非常令人鼓舞的消息，让我们有理由抱有希望。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Carl, as good as this news from Pfizer is, it does come at a pretty scary moment in the pandemic as the second wave of the virus washes over the United States.
sentences.zh: 卡尔，尽管辉瑞的这个好消息令人欣慰，但它确实发生在这场大流行中一个相当可怕的时刻，当时第二波病毒正席卷美国。

sentences.en: And because of the presidential election, we have not really talked a lot about where things stand with the virus in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 由于总统大选，我们实际上并没有过多讨论美国病毒的现状。

sentences.en: So catch us up.
sentences.zh: 所以给我们介绍一下最新情况。

sentences.en: Where are we in the pandemic right now?
sentences.zh: 我们目前在大流行中处于什么位置？

sentences.en: We're in a really bad place.
sentences.zh: 我们处在一个非常糟糕的境地。

sentences.en: For the past week, the average number of new cases a day in the United
sentences.zh: 在过去的一周里，美国每天新增病例的平均数

sentences.en: States has been over 123,000.
sentences.zh: 已经超过了123,000例。

sentences.en: Staggering.
sentences.zh: 令人震惊。

sentences.en: Every day, people are testing positive in huge numbers.
sentences.zh: 每天都有大量的人检测呈阳性。

sentences.en: On November 10th, 1,448 people were reported dead from COVID.
sentences.zh: 11月10日，据报道有1,448人死于新冠。

sentences.en: We have now gone over 240,000 deaths.
sentences.zh: 我们的死亡人数现已超过24万。

sentences.en: And the hospitalizations are reaching record levels.
sentences.zh: 住院人数正达到创纪录的水平。

sentences.en: You're starting to get reports of hospitals in various places that are full up.
sentences.zh: 你开始听到各地医院爆满的报告。

sentences.en: They can't take more people.
sentences.zh: 他们无法接收更多的人。

sentences.en: Their ICU's are full.
sentences.zh: 他们的重症监护室已经满了。

sentences.en: They're understaffed now, not just because of the demand, because of COVID patients, but because the hospital staff itself is getting sick and is having to stay home.
sentences.zh: 他们现在人手不足，不仅是因为需求，因为新冠患者，还因为医院员工本身也生病了，不得不待在家里。

sentences.en: In North Dakota, things have gotten so bad that actually the governor said that he wants nurses who are infected but asymptomatic to keep working, which is not a good idea.
sentences.zh: 在北达科他州，情况变得如此糟糕，以至于州长实际上表示，他希望受到感染但没有症状的护士继续工作，这不是一个好主意。

sentences.en: But that's how desperate things have gotten.
sentences.zh: 但情况已经变得如此绝望。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This sounds just as bad, perhaps even worse, than in the spring when we were told this is as bad as it's going to get.
sentences.zh: 这听起来和春天时一样糟糕，甚至可能更糟，当时有人告诉我们情况不会再恶化了。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: And I think also part of the problem is that people have, for whatever reason, decided that they're kind of done with this.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为部分问题还在于，出于某种原因，人们已经决定他们对这一切有点厌倦了。

sentences.en: You know, people who may have, you know, made those sacrifices for the past few months and, you know, not seeing friends and family, not going out to restaurants.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那些在过去几个月里可能做出过牺牲的人，你知道，不去看望朋友和家人，不出去吃饭。

sentences.en: They're like, okay, I've had it.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得，好吧，我受够了。

sentences.en: I want to get on with my life.
sentences.zh: 我想继续我的生活。

sentences.en: And yet, Carl, correct me if I'm wrong, the death rate from the virus in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 然而，卡尔，如果我没记错的话，纠正我一下，美国病毒的死亡率

sentences.en: appears to be
sentences.zh: 似乎在

sentences.en: slowing down.
sentences.zh: 放缓。

sentences.en: Feels like fewer people are dying given the number infected.
sentences.zh: 感觉鉴于感染人数，死亡人数变少了。

sentences.en: Is that a positive sign?
sentences.zh: 这是一个积极的信号吗？

sentences.en: It's definitely a positive sign.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是一个积极的信号。

sentences.en: So if you look at particular hospitals that were dealing with a lot of cases all of a sudden in the spring, the rate at which their hospitalized patients are dying is much
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你看看在春天突然应对大量病例的特定医院，其住院患者的死亡率现在要

sentences.en: lower now.
sentences.zh: 低得多。

sentences.en: And there's probably a number of different reasons for that.
sentences.zh: 这背后可能有很多不同的原因。

sentences.en: One is that they are just getting to know this disease better.
sentences.zh: 一是他们对这种疾病有了更多的了解。

sentences.en: There are treatments like certain kinds of steroids that seem to be very, very effective, which is great.
sentences.zh: 有一些疗法，比如某些类型的类固醇，似乎非常、非常有效，这太棒了。

sentences.en: But another reason probably that this death rate seemed to have been going down was that our hospitals were not overflowing with COVID patients.
sentences.zh: 但死亡率似乎在下降的另一个原因可能是，我们的医院没有挤满新冠患者。

sentences.en: Doctors and nurses had more time to spend more care on each patient.
sentences.zh: 医生和护士有更多的时间花在每个患者身上。

sentences.en: So going forward, we can look forward to that superior medical knowledge being used by our incredible nurses and doctors.
sentences.zh: 因此，展望未来，我们可以期待我们出色的护士和医生运用这种高超的医学知识。

sentences.en: But they're going to be getting stretched really thin.
sentences.zh: 但他们将面临极大的压力。

sentences.en: They're already stretched really thin.
sentences.zh: 他们已经承受着极大的压力。

sentences.en: It's going to get worse.
sentences.zh: 情况会变得更糟。

sentences.en: And so if there aren't enough staff to give that good care, then the death rate is going to go up.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果没有足够的员工来提供良好的护理，死亡率就会上升。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So in other words, the low death rate is contingent upon hospital beds being open.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，低死亡率取决于医院病床是否空置。

sentences.en: And right now, because of everything you just described, those hospital beds are being filled, which could then lead to more people dying.
sentences.zh: 而现在，由于你刚才描述的一切，这些病床正在被填满，这反过来可能导致更多人死亡。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And also, there's just a basic arithmetic here.
sentences.zh: 而且，这里还有一个基本的算术问题。

sentences.en: If the death rate goes down, then you might expect fewer deaths.
sentences.zh: 如果死亡率下降，那么你可能会预期死亡人数减少。

sentences.en: But if the infection rate goes way up, then even a lower death rate means a lot more deaths.
sentences.zh: 但如果感染率大幅上升，那么即使是较低的死亡率也意味着更多的死亡人数。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And Carl, we are, of course, coming up on a major holiday here in the United States.
sentences.zh: 卡尔，当然，我们即将在美国迎来一个重大节日。

sentences.en: Thanksgiving, traditionally a moment when members of families travel large distances to be with one another.
sentences.zh: 感恩节，传统上家庭成员长途跋涉聚在一起的时刻。

sentences.en: And so I have to imagine that this is an especially dangerous moment in the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 因此，我不得不认为这是大流行中一个特别危险的时刻。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: I'm very concerned about all the traveling that may happen for Thanksgiving and
sentences.zh: 我非常担心感恩节和

sentences.en: Christmas.
sentences.zh: 圣诞节期间可能发生的所有旅行。

sentences.en: People are going to mix together.
sentences.zh: 人们将会混杂在一起。

sentences.en: They may cross state borders.
sentences.zh: 他们可能会跨越州界。

sentences.en: And one day you may say, like, I feel fine.
sentences.zh: 也许有一天你会说，我感觉很好。

sentences.en: I can go to grandma's house and have Thanksgiving.
sentences.zh: 我可以去奶奶家过感恩节。

sentences.en: You could be asymptomatic and not know it.
sentences.zh: 你可能没有症状却浑然不知。

sentences.en: If people come together and one of them is infected, it's very easy for it to infect everybody else.
sentences.zh: 如果人们聚在一起，其中一人被感染，其他人很容易就会被传染。

sentences.en: So, Carl, I'm going to ask you to channel your inner Donald Gene McNeil Jr.
sentences.zh: 所以，卡尔，我要请你在这里展现一下

sentences.en: here.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·吉恩·麦克尼尔·小（Donald Gene McNeil Jr.）的风范。
zh_words: 唐纳德·吉恩·麦克尼尔·小（

sentences.en: Should people avoid traveling to see their families on Thanksgiving, for Christmas, for Hanukkah,
sentences.zh: 人们是否应该避免在感恩节、圣诞节、光明节、

sentences.en: for Kwanzaa, for all the big holidays that are happening this fall and this winter?
sentences.zh: 宽扎节以及今年秋天和冬天发生的所有盛大节日期间出行探亲？

sentences.en: So, I'm not taking my family to see my parents for Thanksgiving.
sentences.zh: 所以，我不会带我的家人去看望我的父母过感恩节。

sentences.en: They live three hours away.
sentences.zh: 他们住在三个小时车程之外。

sentences.en: My family is none too pleased with this because they want to see grandma and grandpa.
sentences.zh: 我的家人对此很不高兴，因为他们想见爷爷奶奶。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But I don't think it's safe.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这并不安全。

sentences.en: And what I'm thinking is, like, you know, maybe one of us is carrying the virus and we're going to give it to my parents who are not that young.
sentences.zh: 我的想法是，你知道，也许我们中有人携带病毒，我们要把它传给年纪不轻的父母。

sentences.en: So, that is my choice.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是我的选择。

sentences.en: Now, obviously, everybody needs to try to understand all the risks that we face in this time.
sentences.zh: 现在，很显然，每个人都需要努力了解我们在这个时期面临的所有风险。

sentences.en: And we have to manage those risks.
sentences.zh: 我们必须管理这些风险。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: I should say, Carl, my mother called me a few days ago and she said, in a very formal way, I relieve you of all guilt for not coming home for Thanksgiving.
sentences.zh: 我得说，卡尔，我母亲几天前给我打电话，她以一种非常正式的语气说，我免除你因不回家过感恩节而感到的所有内疚。

sentences.en: It's about a two-hour drive.
sentences.zh: 车程大约两个小时。

sentences.en: And I appreciated being relieved of that guilt.
sentences.zh: 我很感激能免除这种内疚感。

sentences.en: I'm glad she absolved you.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴她免除了你的内疚。

sentences.en: And my parents understand, too, and I'm grateful for that.
sentences.zh: 我的父母也很理解，对此我很感激。

sentences.en: But I also understand grandparents who have been deprived of grandchildren for months and months and months.
sentences.zh: 但我也理解那些几个月、几个月、几个月见不到孙辈的祖父母。

sentences.en: I get it.
sentences.zh: 我懂。

sentences.en: We want to pretend that this doesn't matter anymore.
sentences.zh: 我们想假装这不再重要了。

sentences.en: But in fact, we're actually in a worse place now than we were in the spring.
sentences.zh: 但事实上，我们现在的处境实际上比春天还要糟糕。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The danger is even greater.
sentences.zh: 危险甚至更大。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: Carl, as you know, we have a new president-elect who talks about the virus in a very different way than the current president.
sentences.zh: 卡尔，如你所知，我们有一位新当选的总统，他谈论病毒的方式与现任总统非常不同。

sentences.en: I wonder if the public health officials that you talk to, the scientists you speak with, do they think that having a new administration with a different
sentences.zh: 我想知道你交谈过的公共卫生官员、你交谈过的科学家，他们是否认为拥有一个对病毒采取不同态度、

sentences.en: and much more hands-on approach to the virus could make a difference?
sentences.zh: 且更加亲力亲为的方法的新政府会有所不同？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: The science shows that a more aggressive approach could make a difference.
sentences.zh: 科学表明，更具攻击性的方法可能会有所不同。

sentences.en: You could save hundreds of thousands of lives with universal masking and other kinds of measures.
sentences.zh: 通过全民佩戴口罩和其他类型的措施，你可以挽救数十万人的生命。

sentences.en: So if our leaders decide to do that, that can make a big difference.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果我们的领导人决定这样做，那将会带来巨大的不同。

sentences.en: But I will point out that the Biden administration will not begin until late January.
sentences.zh: 但我要指出的是，拜登政府要到1月下旬才会开始。

sentences.en: We have this promising vaccine data now, but it will take time for it to get approved and for people to get it.
sentences.zh: 我们现在有有希望的疫苗数据，但它需要时间才能获得批准并让人们接种。

sentences.en: And we have a new administration, which will probably have a very different approach to the virus, but it won't be taking office for weeks.
sentences.zh: 我们有一个新政府，它对病毒的方法可能会非常不同，但它还要过几周才会上任。

sentences.en: So what we do right now will make a big difference about who lives and who dies this winter.
sentences.zh: 所以我们现在所做的事情，将对今年冬天谁生谁死产生重大影响。

sentences.en: Thank you, Carl.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，卡尔。

sentences.en: We really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们真的很感激。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
